name: Omnea 'The Agentic OS for Procurement' social card by omnea.co
description: The card is a single typographic statement on a warm cream field: a two-line high-contrast serif headline set at roughly 150px dominates the 1200×630 canvas, with no logo competing for attention. Four white pill chips ('Mitigation Agent', '4th Party Agent', etc.) are scattered asymmetrically around the type — top-right, mid-left, lower-right, bottom-centre — each pairing an uppercase monospace label with a small halftone dot orb in muted red, blue or green, the only saturated colour on the card. Chips slightly overlap the headline's edges, creating a shallow depth that makes the static card feel like agents orbiting the product claim.
